messages.author: 5063fec87cce1b2f
messages.subject: Error after successful upload to shinyapps.io
parts:
I had uploaded an app to Shinyapps.io on Monday (12/15/14) evening.  It was working successfully with no problems as recently as yesterday afternoon.  This afternoon (12/17/14), I tried to view it online but see only the error below at the URL: stevenranney.shinyapps.io/gradeInflation

Does anyone have any idea what's going on?

Thanks - 

Steven
